UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -e; DEST=\"./Server76/bin\"; mkdir -p \"$DEST\"; OVR=\"{{ReleaseDateOverride}}\"; DL=\"\"; if [ -n \"$OVR\" ]; then if wget -q --spider \"https://myfo.online/releases/linuxrelease_${OVR}.7z\"; then DL=\"$OVR\"; else echo \"Pinned build $OVR not found at myfo.online.\"; exit 1; fi; else for i in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do D=$(date -I -d \"-$i day\"); if wget -q --spider \"https://myfo.online/releases/linuxrelease_${D}.7z\"; then DL=\"$D\"; break; fi; done; if [ -z \"$DL\" ]; then echo \"No Server76 release found in the last 8 days. Check the project Discord for a new URL, then set a Release Date Override.\"; exit 1; fi; fi; echo \"Downloading Server76 build ${DL}...\"; wget -q -O /tmp/server76_${DL}.7z \"https://myfo.online/releases/linuxrelease_${DL}.7z\"; 7zr x -o\"$DEST\" -aoa /tmp/server76_${DL}.7z >/dev/null; rm -f /tmp/server76_${DL}.7z; chmod +x \"$DEST/Server76.Server\"; echo \"Server76 build ${DL} installed to $DEST.\""

-c "set -e; U=\"{{SteamUsername}}\"; P=\"{{SteamPassword}}\"; if [ -z \"$U\" ] || [ -z \"$P\" ]; then echo \"Steam username/password not set - skipping game-file download.\"; exit 0; fi; DEST=\"./Server76/bin/gamedata/Data\"; mkdir -p \"$DEST\"; STEAMCMD=$(command -v steamcmd || echo /usr/games/steamcmd); RS=$(mktemp); printf 'login %s %s\\ndownload_depot 1151340 1151343 9006394379407093964\\ndownload_depot 1151340 1151342 1065890720657377764\\nquit\\n' \"$U\" \"$P\" > \"$RS\"; \"$STEAMCMD\" +runscript \"$RS\" || true; rm -f \"$RS\"; C=\"$HOME/.local/share/Steam/steamcmd/linux32/steamapps/content/app_1151340\"; if [ ! -d \"$C\" ]; then echo \"SteamCMD produced no content (likely a Steam Guard 2FA prompt). Place the game files manually - see the guide.\"; exit 0; fi; find \"$C\" -type d -iname Data -exec sh -c 'cp -rn \"$1\"/. \"$0\"/' \"$DEST\" {} \\; 2>/dev/null || true; find \"$C\" -type f \\( -iname \"*.esm\" -o -iname \"*.ba2\" \\) -exec cp -n {} \"$DEST/\" \\; ; echo \"Game files copied to $DEST (verify SeventySix.esm, NW.esm, .ba2 files and Terrain/Appalachia.btd are present).\""

-c "set -e; SD=\"./Server76/bin/ServerData\"; if [ -d \"$SD/CSV\" ] && [ ! -e \"$SD/csv\" ]; then ln -s \"CSV\" \"$SD/csv\"; echo \"Added case-sensitive csv symlink.\"; fi; mkdir -p \"$SD/overrides\"; echo \"Applied case-sensitivity + overrides fixups (safe to skip if ServerData not built yet).\""
